crm_pipelines_workspace_default_uq.name: crm_pipelines_workspace_default_uq
crm_pipelines_workspace_default_uq.where: is_default = true and deleted_at is null

crm_stages_pipeline_won_uq.name: crm_stages_pipeline_won_uq
crm_stages_pipeline_won_uq.where: is_won = true and deleted_at is null

crm_stages_pipeline_lost_uq.name: crm_stages_pipeline_lost_uq
crm_stages_pipeline_lost_uq.where: is_lost = true and deleted_at is null

housekeeping_checkout_task_uq.name: housekeeping_checkout_task_uq
housekeeping_checkout_task_uq.where: reservation_id is not null and task_type = 'cleaning' and deleted_at is null

invoices_reservation_active_uq.name: invoices_reservation_active_uq
invoices_reservation_active_uq.where: reservation_id is not null and status <> 'void'

invoices_audit_exclusive_ck.name: invoices_audit_exclusive_ck
invoices_audit_exclusive_ck.value: not ("invoices"."voided_at" is not null and "invoices"."written_off_at" is not null)

payments_one_paid_per_booking_uq.name: payments_one_paid_per_booking_uq
payments_one_paid_per_booking_uq.where: status = 'paid' and deleted_at is null and booking_id is not null

payments_exactly_one_link_ck.name: payments_exactly_one_link_ck
payments_exactly_one_link_ck.value: ("payments"."booking_id" is not null) <> ("payments"."invoice_id" is not null)
